Game Overview

Fractal Combat X puts players into a shooter experience centered on pilot advanced jets in Fractal Combat X, where speed and strategy define your aerial combat missions on foreign planets. Upgrade your aircraft, master evasive maneuvers, and engage in thrilling battles to unlock new jets and skills in immersive 3D. Can you dominate the skies with precision and power?
